entry.weibo_post.name: Post Weibo
entry.weibo_post.description: Have Neko post a status on Weibo web using Computer Use Agent. Requires the user to be already logged into Weibo in their browser. content is optional; if omitted Neko will generate based on mood.
entry.weibo_post.param.content: Weibo text content to post (optional; auto-generated if omitted)
entry.weibo_post.param.require_confirm: Whether to ask user for confirmation before executing, default true
entry.weibo_post.error.not_configured: Computer Use Agent not initialized. Please configure the Agent model in N.E.K.O.
entry.weibo_post.error.cua_not_available: Computer Use Agent unavailable (pyautogui or Agent model not ready)
entry.weibo_post.generating: Okay~ let me think of something to post today…
entry.weibo_post.confirm_prompt:
{MASTER_NAME}, can I post this to Weibo?

"{content}"

(After you confirm I'll open Weibo web and post it)
entry.weibo_post.executing: Posting Weibo… don't touch the mouse~
entry.weibo_post.partial: I think it went through but I'm not sure… can you check?
entry.weibo_post.announce: {MASTER_NAME}, I just posted to Weibo~ go check it out!
